description: Create a real invoice in the invoice server for every schedule occurrence on or before as_of that has not been invoiced yet, and render each PDF. Returns what was created, what was skipped and what is still due.

as_of.description: YYYY-MM-DD, defaults to today. Every occurrence on or before this date that has not been invoiced is billed. Idempotent: one invoice per schedule per period, keyed by the occurrence date, so running it twice creates nothing the second time

dry_run.description: List what would be created without creating anything. Default false. One run creates at most 60 invoices, oldest period first

schedule_id.description: Only this schedule. Free and unlimited on every tier

name: invoice_generate_due
title: Generate the invoices that are due
